text: Limassol-based payments company payabl. has reportedly agreed to sell a 50% stake to private equity firm ECM Partners, with Group CEO Ugne Buračienė retaining the remaining 50% (reported August 2026).

source.name: Finance Magnates: payabl. Reportedly Agrees €100M+ Deal as ECM Partners Acquires 50% Stake
source.quote: has reportedly agreed to sell a 50% stake to private equity firm ECM Partners
source.note: Article continues: 'Ugne Buračienė, payabl.’s Group CEO, will retain the remaining 50% stake and continue leading the company.'
